reason: The cited evidence supports that twinning occurs in HEAs at high strain rates (E1) and that twins can enhance both strength and ductility via TWIP (E2). However, the specific claims that a thermomechanical treatment can induce a high, uniform twin density in the proposed refractory alloy (TiZrWMo) and that this will improve ductility without sacrificing strength or energy release are not directly supported by the cited passages, which discuss different alloy systems and general mechanisms.
